study type: Retrospective, two-group, pre- and postintervention design
outcome: Plans to use human milk at discharge
finding: Delaying the newborn bath was associated with increased in-hospital exclusive breastfeeding rates and use of human milk as part of the discharge feeding plan.
mod_finding: The increase in in-hospital exclusive breastfeeding rates after delayed newborn bathing was observed for both vaginal and cesarean births.
